title: Bad coordinate map
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $\{\pm1\}^n$. The bad coordinate map sends each coordinate restriction for which the restricted formula is nonconstant to its first bad coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: input is a coordinate restriction for which the restricted formula is nonconstant
caveat: The referenced definition of the first bad coordinate is not supplied.
